note: Example data: an invented B2B field-service software company and its CRM export, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "lead-scoring-model-builder" skill. Here's our HubSpot leads export for the last 12 months and our current scoring rules. Build a lead scoring model from our real wins and losses, pick the MQL threshold, and tell me what's wrong with the rules we use now. A rep spends about 2 hours on each lead they work.

business.name: Example Field Service Software (invented)
business.what_it_sells: field-service management software on annual contracts for trade contractors
business.sales_motion: inbound leads reviewed by sales, then demo and proposal

crm: HubSpot, uploaded as a CSV export (no CRM connector)

settings.decision_point: mql_review_date: the day sales first reviewed the lead
settings.action_dates: the export has the first date each action happened, not every date
settings.email_clicks: from HubSpot's own marketing email tool, as a date column in the export

rules.rule: Job title is owner or executive

leads_export.format: CSV lines; an empty field means no date
